text: かくちにいる　リーダーを　かちぬく　ことで　バッジが　ふえて　いきます。

structure.jp: かくちにいる　リーダーを
structure.en: the Leaders who are in various places
by beating them one after another

patterns.name: 〜ことで
patterns.explanation: ことで after a verb says that doing this is the way the next thing comes about. かちぬく　ことで = 'by beating them one after another'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says the change keeps going on from now. ふえて　いきます = 'will keep increasing'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: かくちにいる　リーダー
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing tells you which thing it is. かくちにいる　リーダー = 'the Leaders who are in various places'.
